This property in professionally managed by Beach Habitats 30A.

Welcome to Vitamin Sea, a coastal Inlet Beach vacation townhome just steps from Phillips Inlet Beach Access and minutes from Scenic 30A. This 5-bedroom, 5.5-bath retreat is built for multi-family trips and group getaways, pairing “beach-now” convenience with resort-style features: a private courtyard pool and hot tub, elevator access to all floors, a gulf-view balcony, and a garage lounge with ping-pong plus beach gear. Ride the included cruiser bikes to Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, shop and dine at 30Avenue, then come back to your own private oasis.

Home highlights
• 5 bedrooms | 5.5 bathrooms
• private courtyard pool + hot tub, loungers, outdoor shower, and built-in grill
• elevator serving all three levels
• open living level with gulf-view balcony
• garage lounge with ping-pong, beach wagon, chairs, and gear
• cruiser bikes included
• walk to Phillips Inlet Beach Access

Home layout
Third floor
• open-concept kitchen, dining, and living room with gulf-view balcony
• small work/reading nook / office
• primary suite: king bed, ensuite bath with walk-in shower
• pull-out full-size couch
Second floor
• king suite 1: ensuite bath with shower & tub
• king suite 2: ensuite bath with shower & tub
• bunk room: built-in twin/twin bunks (great for kids)
• shared hallway full bathroom with shower/tub combo
First floor
• private apartment: murphy bed, kitchenette, full bath (ideal for grandparents, nanny, or teens)
• full-size pull-out couch.
• courtyard with pool, heated spa, loungers, outdoor shower, and grill
• garage lounge with ping-pong; beach wagon, chairs, and cruiser bikes

Inlet Beach location:
You’re approximately 100–150 yards to Phillips Inlet Beach Access, making it easy to go from coffee to shoreline in minutes. Inlet Beach is known for wide sugar-sand beaches, a more relaxed vibe than some of the busier 30A hubs, and quick access to both ends of your trip—30A charm to the west and Panama City Beach attractions to the east.

Things to do nearby:
• 30A favorites (quick bike/drive)
• Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach: architecture walks, boutique shopping, green spaces, and dining
• Camp Helen State Park: trails, dunes, lake views, and great wildlife spotting

Spend an afternoon at 30Avenue for boutiques and a stacked dining lineup. Popular stops include:
• Amici 30A (Italian)
• Cuvee 30A (wine + small plates)
• Amigos (Mexican)
• Goatfeather's (Seafood)

Or bike over to Rosemary or Alys Beach for fine dining and shopping.

Rosemary Restaurant Suggestions:
• Restaurant Paradis: upscale coastal cuisine and a great date-night pick
• Havana Beach Bar & Grill: cocktails and elevated favorites in a lively setting
• Gallion’s: classic American bistro fare with a polished vibe
• Pescado Seafood Grill & Rooftop Bar: rooftop dining and sunset views (reservations recommended)
• Cowgirl Kitchen: casual tacos, bowls, and family-friendly meals
• La Crema: tapas-style small plates and wine in a cozy atmosphere
• Summer Kitchen Café: popular breakfast and brunch spot
• The Sugar Shak: old-school candy shop that’s a must with kids
• The Pearl Hotel (Havana Beach Bar & Grill): nearby favorite cocktails and elevated coastal fare (easy hop from Alys/Rosemary)

Alys Beach Suggestions:
• George’s at Alys Beach: coastal seafood, craft cocktails, and a lively bar scene
• The Citizen at Alys Beach: refined yet approachable brunch/dinner option with great patio seating
• Raw & Juicy: smoothies, cold-pressed juices, bowls, and lighter breakfast/lunch
• Fonville Press: coffee, pastries, sandwiches, and an easy grab-and-go stop
• Neat: boutique wine bar for a relaxed drink before or after dinner


Panama City Beach + Pier Park (easy day trip):
Vitamin Sea sits in the sweet spot between 30A and Panama City Beach, so you can do low-key beach mornings and big-attraction afternoons:
• Pier Park: shopping, restaurants, and entertainment
• Family attractions in Panama City Beach: mini golf, arcades, watersports, and seasonal events
• Beachfront dining and sunset cruises are also an easy add-on

Why guests love Inlet Beach:
Inlet Beach is a perfect home base because it lets you split your time: bike to the iconic 30A towns (Rosemary/Alys) when you want upscale dining and walkable shopping, then head toward Pier Park and Panama City Beach when you want high-energy entertainment and larger attractions—without sacrificing a peaceful place to come back to at the end of the day.

Good to know:
• parking for 2 vehicles; additional public parking nearby
• pool heat available seasonally (fee)

Book Vitamin Sea for a beach-close Inlet Beach stay with your own private pool and hot tub, elevator convenience, space for the whole crew, and the best of both 30A and Panama City Beach within easy reach.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
